title: Block accidental duplicate characters and background actors
starting_state: A locked intimate scene authorizes exactly one foreground couple and no background people.
The generated image contains a second couple walking away in the corridor, but visual QA still claims PASS because text, style, and anatomy look good.
done_when: Every proof and final slide records expected and observed people counts plus unexpected entities.
A count mismatch, duplicate couple, reflection, silhouette, or extra background actor blocks proof approval and final audit.
Valid scenes with explicitly authorized background people still pass.
forbidden_changes: Do not treat distant, faint, reflected, or symbolic people as exempt from the entity inventory.
Do not block explicitly storyboarded background people when their count and roles are authorized.
Do not replace instance-level checks with a single holistic beauty or prompt-alignment score.
fail_to_pass: a PASS visual QA with expected_people=2, observed_people=4, and an unintended background couple is rejected
pass_to_pass: a two-person scene with exactly two observed people passes, and a crowd scene passes when its background roles and count policy are explicitly authorized
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden variants should use a mirror duplicate, doorway silhouette, tiny third person, framed figure that reads as a live actor, and an explicitly authorized wedding crowd control case.
